control_failures.control_label: parking, chocking and restraint of equipment
positive communication before approaching mobile equipment

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: hazard report during an intrusive maintenance task on HT-9004

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control POSITIVE_COMMUNICATION_BEFORE_APPROACH: the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on HT-9004 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment on HT-9004 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling traffic on operating areas, specifically applying positive communication before approach. HT-9004 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 3 June 2014 a hazard report was recorded on HT-9004 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during an intrusive maintenance task; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
